symbols.name: chirp value
symbols.meaning: The chirp value $\exp(-\pi i p^2/q)$ at the integer $p$, a unit complex number.
symbols.quote: The chirp is $c_p = \exp(-\pi i\, p^2/q)$, the chirp value at an integer $p$.

symbols.name: chirp index
symbols.meaning: The integer at which the chirp is evaluated, which may be negative.
symbols.quote: The chirp is $c_p = \exp(-\pi i\, p^2/q)$, the chirp value at an integer $p$.

relations.quote: Bluestein's chirp identity rewrites the [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) of a vector.
It computes its transform by a [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) sandwiched between two pointwise multiplications by chirp sequences.
Bluestein's chirp identity acts on the middle transform of the paper's multiplication algorithm, including its [target permutation](gaussian-resampling.md).
